# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data silicon.data

# Replicate the structure
replicate 3 3 3

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Define settings for NPT ensemble
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 1363.64 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0

# Output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run the simulation
run 1000000  # 1 million steps for heating

# Equilibrate at 2500K
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
run 250000  # 250k steps for equilibration

# Output MSD for diffusion calculation
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# Run for diffusion calculation
run 500000  # 500k steps for diffusion calculation
